subject: Permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in Edison case study
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@edisonanalytics.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marketing@edisonanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: include SOC 2 / ISO blurb in Edison case study

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the great collaboration on the pilot — the draft case study looks strong. Our comms team asked whether Redwood can provide a short, public-facing statement confirming that Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations and whether we can cite the attestation dates in the case study.

Specifically, would you be able to:
- Provide a 1-paragraph blurb that we can use under the "Security & Compliance" section?
- Confirm exact attestation dates (or a line like "attested as of Oct 2026").
- Confirm whether we can include a short customer-facing quote (2–3 sentences) from a Redwood executive for the headline.

We attached the current draft for context (edison_draft_case_study_v1.docx). Our target publish date is Dec 10; would love to lock wording early next week if possible.

If you prefer, we can route this through legal/security for approval — just let me know the right contact and timeline.

Thanks,
Samantha Wu
Head of Marketing, Edison Analytics
samantha.wu@edisonanalytics.com
(415) 555-0189
(attachment: edison_draft_case_study_v1.docx - DOCX, 120 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@edisonanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: include SOC 2 / ISO blurb in Edison case study

Hi Samantha — great to hear the draft is moving along.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a short public blurb and a quote, but I need to run the exact language and any attestation dates by our security and legal teams for final approval.

Proposed quick blurb (draft):
"Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations. Our control environment is audited annually and summaries are available on request; for detailed audit reports we provide secure access under NDAs to qualified partners."

Would that work in the security section? If so, I’ll ask Security to confirm the attestation dates and approve a 1–2 sentence quote for the header.

Cc'ing Marissa (comms) and Lauren (CS/legal) to align on tone and any redaction guidance. We’ll aim to get a signed-off version by end of next week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: include SOC 2 / ISO blurb in Edison case study

Thanks for looping me in. A couple quick notes from comms/legal perspective:

- Tone: prefer an explicit, customer-facing sentence rather than generic wording. Suggest: "Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified; we undergo annual third-party audits of our control environment."
- Quote: Marketing prefers a line we can use as a pull-quote. Suggested draft (for review): "Working with Edison allowed Redwood to validate our low-latency inference controls in a customer workload — the results reinforce our commitment to secure, reliable model serving." — (can be attributed to Redwood Head of Product).
- Redactions / documents: we should not publish the full SOC 2 report. Security can provide a one-page SOC 2 summary and the ISO certificate for public use.

Lauren — do we need a legal stamp before sending the blurb and attachments to Edison? Also, any suggestions on a short authority line (attestation date) we should use?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:37:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: include SOC 2 / ISO blurb in Edison case study

Hi all — security OK to proceed with the following, cleared for public use:

Approved blurb (final):
"Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II attested and ISO 27001 certified. Both attestations were most recently completed in Oct 2026; we undergo annual third-party audits and maintain continuous controls monitoring."

Approved short quote for the case study (2 sentences):
"Edison’s integration demonstrated Redwood’s ability to deliver secure, production-grade inference at scale. We’re proud to support customers with audited controls and predictable SLAs." — cleared to attribute to: "Head of Product, Redwood Inference"

Attachments for Edison (public/comms):
- redwood_soc2_summary_202611.pdf (one-page summary suitable for public distribution)
- redwood_iso27001_certificate_202610.pdf (official cert image)

Notes/constraints:
- Do not publish or attach the full SOC 2 audit report to the case study or public pages.
- If Edison requests the full report, route via NDA + secure portal; Security will coordinate access.
- Attestation line should use "most recently completed in Oct 2026" (as above).

Rishi — you can send the approved blurb, quote, and the two attachments to Samantha and Edison marketing. Marissa, happy for comms to adjust copy slightly for flow, but only cosmetic changes.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0133
